cards.name: Guardian Project
lines: Whenever a nontoken creature you control enters, if it doesn't have the same name as another creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Condition and Selector schemas cannot compare the entering creature's name with other creatures you control or creature cards in your graveyard (sameNameAsSource reads the source's name, not the entering creature's).

cards.name: Kindred Discovery
lines: Whenever a creature you control of the chosen type enters or attacks, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever a creature you control with the chosen subtype enters, draw a card.
Whenever a creature you control with the chosen subtype attacks, draw a card.

cards.name: Sevinne's Reclamation
lines: Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, you may copy this spell and may choose a new target for the copy.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second sentence ('If this spell was cast from a graveyard, you may copy this spell and may choose a new target for the copy') needs a cast-from-graveyard condition and a copy-of-the-resolving-spell effect, and the schema has neither.

cards.name: Anger
lines: As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control a Mountain, creatures you control have haste.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The haste grant must apply only while this card is in its owner's graveyard, but StaticEffect and its Condition have no zone-of-source test, and static effects only function from the battlefield.

cards.name: Blackblade Reforged
lines: Equip legendary creature {3}
cards.backTranslation: {3}: Attach this to target legendary creature you control. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Shifting Woodland
lines: {2}{G}{G}: ~ becomes a copy of target permanent card in your graveyard until end of turn. Activate only if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
validatorIssues: override.def.activatedAbilities[0].ability.effects[0].ref: cardInGraveyard is incompatible with effect domains permanent
cards.inexpressibleReason: becomeCopyOf only references permanents, so there is no way to become a copy of a permanent card in a graveyard.

cards.name: Aetherflux Reservoir
lines: Whenever you cast a spell, you gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell, you gain life equal to the number of spells cast this turn.
differences: Text A counts only spells you have cast this turn ("spell you've cast this turn"), but Text B counts all spells cast this turn by any player ("the number of spells cast this turn"), so B gains life for opponents' spells too.

cards.name: Mistrise Village
lines: {U}, {T}: The next spell you cast this turn can't be countered.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect or static that makes the next spell cast this turn uncounterable; only a card's own cantBeCountered flag exists, and it cannot be granted to a later spell.

cards.name: Pact of Negation
lines: At the beginning of your next upkeep, pay {3}{U}{U}. If you don't, you lose the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes you lose the game, so the 'if you don't, you lose the game' half of the delayed upkeep payment cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Branching Evolution
lines: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on that creature instead.
cards.backTranslation: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on that creature instead.

cards.name: Helm of the Host
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a token that's a copy of equipped creature, except the token isn't legendary. That token gains haste.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a token that is a copy of equipped creature, except it is nonlegendary and has haste. Create one such token.

cards.name: Demolition Field
lines: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. That land's controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. You may search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. That land's controller may search their library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield untapped. Then search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield untapped. Then shuffle.
differences: Text A makes your search optional ('You may search your library'); Text B makes your search mandatory ('Then search your library ... and put it onto the battlefield untapped').

cards.name: Silence
lines: Your opponents can't cast spells this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: prohibitSpellsThisTurn stops every player from casting spells and has no opponents-only scope, so 'your opponents can't cast spells this turn' cannot be said exactly.

cards.name: Fanatic of Rhonas
lines: Eternalize {2}{G}{G}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Eternalize needs a token copy that is black with no mana cost, and createTokenCopyOf has no color override and no way to remove the copied mana cost.

cards.name: Lotho, Corrupt Shirriff
lines: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, you lose 1 life and create a Treasure token.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, lose 1 life and create a Treasure artifact token with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."

cards.name: Demand Answers
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or discard a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The additional cost is a choice between sacrificing an artifact and discarding a card, but spellAdditionalCosts is a list where every cost is paid, so the either-or cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Cursed Mirror
lines: As this artifact enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste.
cards.inexpressibleReason: entersAsCopy makes a permanent copy with no until-end-of-turn duration, and the schema has no as-enters choice to become a copy until end of turn; becomeCopyOf is an ability effect, not an as-enters replacement.

cards.name: Enduring Vitality
lines: When ~ dies, if it was a creature, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. It's an enchantment.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "It's an enchantment" (the returned permanent is no longer a creature) has no schema field for a type change on the object after it returns from the graveyard; removeCreatureType as a static would apply while it is still on the battlefield as a creature.

cards.name: Welcoming Vampire
lines: Whenever one or more other creatures you control with power 2 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever one or more other creatures you control with power 2 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Unnatural Growth
lines: At the beginning of each combat, double the power and toughness of each creature you control until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of combat on each player's turn, double the power and toughness of each creature you control until end of turn.

cards.name: Cabal Ritual
lines: Add {B}{B}{B}{B}{B} instead if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: Add {B}{B}{B}. If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, add {B}{B}{B}{B}{B} instead.

cards.name: Simian Spirit Guide
lines: Exile this card from your hand: Add {R}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A mana ability can only live on a battlefield permanent, and the only hand-zone activated ability is a stack ability whose exile-from-hand cost is expressed only as a casting cost, so 'Exile this card from your hand: Add {R}' has no exact form.

cards.name: Hall of Heliod's Generosity
lines: {1}{W}, {T}: Put target enchantment card from your graveyard on top of your library.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{W}, {T}: Put target enchantment card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Bident of Thassa
lines: {1}{U}, {T}: Creatures your opponents control attack this turn if able.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{U}, {T}: Each creature your opponents control attacks if able.

cards.name: Thassa's Oracle
lines: When this creature enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is your devotion to blue. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If X is greater than or equal to the number of cards in your library, you win the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: lookAtTopN takes a fixed number for count, not the devotion Value X, and no effect wins the game when X is at least the library size.

cards.name: Entish Restoration
lines: Sacrifice a land. Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, instead search your library for up to three basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation:
Sacrifice a land you control.
If the greatest power among creatures you control is 4 or greater, search your library for three basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
Otherwise, search your library for two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches for up to two (resp. up to three) basic lands, so the player may find fewer; Text B says search for exactly two (resp. three) basic land cards with no 'up to' option.

cards.name: Chandra's Ignition
lines: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'and each opponent' damage must be dealt by the targeted creature (its power, as source), but the opponent-damage op eachOpponentDamage carries no damage source, so that half cannot be modeled exactly.

cards.name: Commander's Plate
lines: Equipped creature gets +3/+3 and has protection from each color that's not in your commander's color identity.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Protection from each color not in your commander's color identity needs a protection set computed from the commander's color identity, and layer 6 protection takes only fixed colors.

cards.name: Accursed Marauder
lines: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
cards.inexpressibleReason: sacrificeEachPlayer accepts only the filters 'creature' or 'any', so it cannot restrict each player's sacrifice to nontoken creatures.

cards.name: Mental Misstep
lines: Counter target spell with mana value 1.
cards.backTranslation: Counter target spell with mana value 1.

cards.name: Rise of the Dark Realms
lines: Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
cards.backTranslation: Put each creature card from all graveyards onto the battlefield.
differences: Text A puts the creature cards under your control; Text B does not say who controls them, so the owners would get them.

cards.name: Voice of Victory
lines: Mobilize 2
cards.inexpressibleReason: Mobilize's tapped-and-attacking Warrior tokens must be sacrificed at the next end step, and createTokenAttacking has no sacrifice option (sacrificeAt exists only on token copies).

cards.name: Maskwood Nexus
lines: Creatures you control are every creature type. The same is true for creature spells you control and creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The off-battlefield clause (creature spells you control and creature cards you own are every creature type) cannot be expressed: alsoTypesOffBattlefield adds card types only, not every creature subtype.

cards.name: Field of the Dead
lines: Whenever this land or another land you control enters, if you control seven or more lands with different names, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Condition schema counts permanents or same-name lands but has no condition for having seven or more lands with different names.

cards.name: Liquimetal Torque
lines: {T}: Target nonland permanent becomes an artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect op adds a card type to a target permanent until end of turn: becomeCopyOfTarget copies characteristics and becomeCreatureUntilEot is creature-only.

cards.name: Chord of Calling
lines: Search your library for a creature card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The library search is bounded by mana value X, and the only searchLibrary form takes a constant mana value; the Value-bounded search op (searchLibraryAndOrGraveyardToBattlefield) also allows the graveyard, which the line does not.

cards.name: Overwhelming Stampede
lines: Until end of turn, creatures you control gain trample and get +X/+X, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
cards.backTranslation:
Each creature you control gets +N/+N until end of turn, where N is the greatest power among creatures you control.
Each creature you control gains trample until end of turn.

cards.name: Veil of Summer
lines: Draw a card if an opponent has cast a blue or black spell this turn. Spells you control can't be countered this turn. You and permanents you control gain hexproof from blue and from black until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Hexproof from blue and from black (a color-specific hexproof grant) has no keyword or op in the schema; only plain hexproof exists.

cards.name: Gitaxian Probe
lines: Look at target player's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect op lets the controller look at a target player's hand without also revealing and discarding it (revealHandAndDiscard), so 'Look at target player's hand' has no exact form.

cards.name: Bonders' Enclave
lines: {3}, {T}: Draw a card. Activate only if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
cards.backTranslation: {3}, {T}: Draw a card. Activate only if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.

cards.name: Ripples of Undeath
lines: At the beginning of your first main phase, mill three cards. Then you may pay {1} and 3 life. If you do, put a card from among those cards into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mill-then-optional-payment-then-pick sequence cannot be expressed: millThenReturnMilledCard mills and returns in one mandatory op with no payment gate, and mill has no binding for choosing a card from the milled cards after a "you may pay {1} and 3 life" decision.

cards.name: Green Sun's Zenith
lines: Search your library for a green creature card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Shuffle ~ into its owner's library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: searchLibrary's manaValueAtMost takes a fixed number, so it cannot bound the found creature by the announced X.

cards.name: Emergence Zone
lines: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect or rule static that lets the controller cast spells this turn as though they had flash.

cards.name: Sword of Feast and Famine
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card and you untap all lands you control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card. Untap each land you control.

cards.name: Laboratory Maniac
lines: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The replacement 'you win the game instead' of a draw from an empty library has no schema form; emptyLibraryCreatureReplacement only returns a creature card.

cards.name: Second Harvest
lines: For each token you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "For each token you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent" needs a per-token copy of each distinct token, and the schema's createTokenCopyOf copies a single fixed reference a counted number of times.

cards.name: Maze of Ith
lines: {T}: Untap target attacking creature. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Untap target attacking creature. Create a combat-only damage shield on that creature that applies to damage dealt to it and damage dealt by it.
differences: Text A prevents all combat damage dealt to and dealt by the creature for the rest of the turn; Text B creates a damage shield with no stated duration, which is a different prevention scope and duration than preventing all damage this turn.

cards.name: Nesting Grounds
lines: {1}, {T}: Move a counter from target permanent you control onto a second target permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: moveCounters needs one named counter kind, and the schema has no way to move a counter of any kind chosen by the controller (moveAllCounters moves every kind).

cards.name: Conduit of Worlds
lines: {T}: Choose target nonland permanent card in your graveyard. If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card. If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets the controller cast a targeted nonland permanent card from their graveyard under the 'if you haven't cast a spell this turn' condition, with the 'can't cast additional spells this turn' restriction.

cards.name: Beastmaster Ascension
lines: As long as this enchantment has seven or more quest counters on it, creatures you control get +5/+5.
cards.backTranslation: As long as this enchantment has seven or more quest counters on it, creatures you control get +5/+5.

cards.name: Saw in Half
lines: Destroy target creature. If that creature dies this way, its controller creates two tokens that are copies of that creature, except their power is half that creature's power and their toughness is half that creature's toughness. Round up each time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no Value that halves a power or toughness rounded up, so the token copies' half-size P/T cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Curiosity
lines: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].trigger.subject: opponent damage currently supports only the damaging source's own ability
cards.inexpressibleReason: dealsDamageToOpponent only supports the source's own ability, so a trigger on the enchanted creature controlled by the Aura's controller cannot be said (granting it via addTrigger would give the draw to the creature's controller).

cards.name: Thespian's Stage
lines: {2}, {T}: ~ becomes a copy of target land, except it has this ability.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "This land becomes a copy of target land, except it has this ability" needs the copy to keep its own {2}, {T} ability, and the only way to grant it back is a self-referential ability that cannot be written as finite JSON.

cards.name: Teferi's Ageless Insight
lines: If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no draw-replacement effect ("if you would draw a card, draw two cards instead" is a CR 614 replacement with no RuleStatic or StaticEffect kind for it), and a triggered approximation would not replace the draw.

cards.name: Culling Ritual
lines: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less. Add {B} or {G} for each permanent destroyed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mana added 'for each permanent destroyed this way' needs a Value counting the permanents this destroy actually destroyed, and the schema has no such Value.

cards.name: Access Tunnel
lines: {3}, {T}: Target creature with power 3 or less can't be blocked this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'power 3 or less' would need powerAtMost, which the schema marks event-only and so not a reliable target filter.

cards.name: Strionic Resonator
lines: {2}, {T}: Copy target triggered ability you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.backTranslation: {2}, {T}: Copy target triggered ability you control on the stack. The copy may have new targets chosen for it.

cards.name: Realmwalker
lines: You may cast creature spells of the chosen type from the top of your library.
cards.backTranslation: You may cast creature spells of the chosen subtype from the top of your library.

cards.name: Banner of Kinship
lines: As this artifact enters, choose a creature type. ~ enters with a fellowship counter on it for each creature you control of the chosen type.
cards.backTranslation:
As this artifact enters, choose a creature type.
This artifact enters with a fellowship counter on it for each creature you control of the chosen type.

cards.name: Emry, Lurker of the Loch
lines: {T}: Choose target artifact card in your graveyard. You may cast that card this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants permission to cast a chosen graveyard card this turn at its normal cost; the graveyard cast permissions cover only lands (playFromZone) or the card's own castFromGraveyard, so 'you may cast that card this turn' cannot be said.

cards.name: Tribute to the World Tree
lines: Whenever a creature you control enters, draw a card if its power is 3 or greater. Otherwise, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature's power is 3 or greater, draw a card. Otherwise, put two +1/+1 counters on that creature.

cards.name: Ancient Copper Dragon
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. You create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the result.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no die-roll effect, so "roll a d20 and create Treasure tokens equal to the result" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Shizo, Death's Storehouse
lines: {B}, {T}: Target legendary creature gains fear until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Fear' is not a keyword in the schema's keyword list, so granting fear to the target legendary creature cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Torment of Hailfire
lines: Repeat the following process X times. Each opponent loses 3 life unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice or discards a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Repeat the following process X times' has no repetition op in the schema, so the per-opponent sacrifice, discard or life-loss choice cannot be repeated X times.

cards.name: Aftermath Analyst
lines: {3}{G}, Sacrifice this creature: Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: graveyardToBattlefieldEach has no tapped flag, so the schema cannot return the lands tapped.

cards.name: Greater Good
lines: Sacrifice a creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power, then discard three cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power needs a Value reading the power of a creature sacrificed as a cost, and the only such Value (stationPower) is for Station activations.

cards.name: Noxious Revival
lines: Put target card from a graveyard on top of its owner's library.
cards.backTranslation: Put target card from a graveyard on top of its owner's library.

cards.name: Plaguecrafter
lines: When this creature enters, each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice. Each player who can't discards a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: sacrificeEachPlayer filters only creatures or any permanent, so "sacrifices a creature or planeswalker" cannot be stated, and no op makes each player who cannot sacrifice discard a card.

cards.name: Open the Armory
lines: Search your library for an Aura or Equipment card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search a library for a card that is an Aura enchantment or an Equipment artifact. Reveal that card and put it into hand. Then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches your library; Text B searches a library, which allows searching any player's library.

cards.name: All That Glitters
lines: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact and/or enchantment you control.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each artifact or enchantment you control.

cards.name: Altar of Dementia
lines: Sacrifice a creature: Target player mills cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: millTargetPlayer takes a fixed count, so "mills cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power" (a value read from the sacrificed object) cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Gravecrawler
lines: You may cast this card from your graveyard as long as you control a Zombie.
cards.inexpressibleReason: castFromGraveyard is an unconditional permission and the schema has no condition field for 'as long as you control a Zombie'.

cards.name: Ozolith, the Shattered Spire
lines: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on an artifact or creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
cards.backTranslation: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on an artifact or creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on that permanent instead.

cards.name: Borne Upon a Wind
lines: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect or rule static that lets the controller cast spells this turn as though they had flash.

cards.name: Treasure Cruise
lines: Delve
cards.inexpressibleReason: Delve (exiling cards from your graveyard to pay generic cost) is not a keyword or cost form in the schema.

cards.name: Trailblazer's Boots
lines: Equipped creature has nonbasic landwalk.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no landwalk keyword or static, so "equipped creature has nonbasic landwalk" cannot be expressed (keywords lists only unparameterized keywords, and no ContinuousOp grants landwalk).

cards.name: Distant Melody
lines: Choose a creature type. Draw a card for each permanent you control of that type.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A resolving spell has no way to choose a creature type on resolution: the only creature-type choice (entersChoosingOption) happens as a permanent enters, so the "choose a creature type" for the chosenSubtype draw count cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Windbrisk Heights
lines: {W}, {T}: You may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition or value counts the creatures that attacked this turn; attackingCreatures counts only those attacking right now, so 'if you attacked with three or more creatures this turn' cannot be stated.

cards.name: Starting Town
lines: ~ enters tapped unless it's your first, second, or third turn of the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition can test the game's turn number, so 'enters tapped unless it's your first, second, or third turn of the game' cannot be said.

cards.name: Haywire Mite
lines: {G}, Sacrifice this creature: Exile target noncreature artifact or noncreature enchantment.
cards.backTranslation: {G}, Sacrifice this creature: Exile target artifact or enchantment that isn't a creature.

cards.name: Shared Animosity
lines: Whenever a creature you control attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn for each other attacking creature that shares a creature type with it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The bonus is +1/+0 for each other attacking creature sharing a creature type with the attacker, and no Value counts attacking creatures by shared creature type.

cards.name: Changeling Outcast
lines: ~ can't block and can't be blocked.
cards.backTranslation:
This creature can't block.
This creature can't be blocked.

cards.name: Sphere of Safety
lines: Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {X} for each of those creatures, where X is the number of enchantments you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: attackTax takes a fixed numeric amount per creature, so the per-creature tax of "{X}, where X is the number of enchantments you control" cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Kindred Dominance
lines: Choose a creature type. Destroy all creatures that aren't of the chosen type.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no resolution-time choice of a creature type for a spell, so the chosen type cannot be stored and then used by the destroy-all filter.

cards.name: Curse of Opulence
lines: Whenever enchanted player is attacked, create a Gold token. Each opponent attacking that player does the same.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever enchanted player is attacked, create a Gold artifact token. Then create a Gold artifact token for the event player, but only if that player is an opponent of you.
Each Gold token has "Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."

cards.name: Reflections of Littjara
lines: Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen type, copy that spell.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell with the chosen subtype, copy that spell.

cards.name: Fact or Fiction
lines: Reveal the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: An opponent separating the revealed top five cards into two piles, with the controller choosing one pile for hand, has no schema form (the only pile effect is specific to other cards).

cards.name: Chasm Skulker
lines: When this creature dies, create X 1/1 blue Squid creature tokens with islandwalk, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Squid tokens need islandwalk, which is not a KeywordAbility in the schema (TokenSpec keywords accept only those).

cards.name: Archivist of Oghma
lines: Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for an opponent searching their library (TriggerHead has no search event).

cards.name: Springheart Nantuko
lines: Whenever a land you control enters, you may pay {1}{G} if this permanent is attached to a creature you control. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature. If you didn't create a token this way, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition reads whether this permanent is attached to a creature you control, so the 'pay {1}{G} if attached, copy that creature' option cannot be gated exactly.

cards.name: Mortuary Mire
lines: When this land enters, you may put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.
cards.backTranslation: When this land enters, you may put target creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Muddle the Mixture
lines: Transmute {1}{U}{U}
cards.backTranslation: {1}{U}{U}, Discard this card: Search your library for a card with mana value 2, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery and only from your hand.
differences: Transmute in Text A searches for a card with the same mana value as this card ({1}{U}{U}, mana value 3); Text B searches for a card with mana value 2.

cards.name: Imperial Recruiter
lines: When this creature enters, search your library for a creature card with power 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search filter has no non-event 'power 2 or less' selector (powerAtMost is event-only), so 'a creature card with power 2 or less' cannot be stated for a library search.

cards.name: Narset's Reversal
lines: Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it to its owner's hand. You may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.backTranslation: Copy target instant or sorcery spell. The copy may have new targets chosen. Then return the original spell to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Whip of Erebos
lines: {2}{B}{B}, {T}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step. If it would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no delayed exile at the beginning of the next end step (any player's, not only yours) for a reanimated creature, nor a replacement that exiles it instead of letting it leave the battlefield from anywhere.

cards.name: Life from the Loam
lines: Dredge 3
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no dredge keyword or draw-replacement that lets this card be returned from the graveyard to hand in place of a draw.

cards.name: Tyvar's Stand
lines: Target creature you control gets +X/+X and gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the value chosen for X. That creature gains hexproof until end of turn. That creature gains indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
lines: As long as your devotion to red is less than five, ~ isn't a creature.
cards.backTranslation: As long as your devotion to red is 4 or less, this loses all creature types.
differences: Text A makes the permanent stop being a creature (it 'isn't a creature'); Text B says it loses all creature types, which removes subtypes but leaves it a creature.

cards.name: Riveteers Overlook
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Swamp, Mountain, or Forest card (you may find none), put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
differences: Text B adds '(you may find none)', making the search optional; Text A's search is mandatory and the player must find a matching card if one exists.

cards.name: Hammer of Nazahn
lines: Whenever ~ or another Equipment you control enters, you may attach that Equipment to target creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The attach op can only move the source or the trigger object to the trigger object or a created token, so "you may attach that Equipment to target creature you control" (attaching the entering Equipment to a chosen target) cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Howling Mine
lines: At the beginning of each player's draw step, if this artifact is untapped, that player draws an additional card.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of each player's draw step, if this is untapped, that player draws a card.

cards.name: Mockingbird
lines: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield with mana value less than or equal to the amount of mana spent to cast this creature, except it's a Bird in addition to its other types and it has flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The as-enters copy selector takes a fixed mana value limit (manaValueAtMost n), so it cannot be bound to the mana spent to cast the creature.

cards.name: Champion's Helm
lines: As long as equipped creature is legendary, it has hexproof.
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature that is legendary has hexproof.

cards.name: Flare of Fortitude
lines: Until end of turn, your life total can't change, and permanents you control gain hexproof and indestructible.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Your life total can't change' until end of turn has no schema op; only the until-next-turn Teferi-style protection carries a life lock.

cards.name: Lion's Eye Diamond
lines: Discard your hand, Sacrifice this artifact: Add three mana of any one color. Activate only as an instant.
cards.backTranslation: Discard your hand, Sacrifice this artifact: Add three mana, linked so that all three are the same color, chosen from white, blue, black, red, or green.
differences: Text A says the mana ability can be activated only as an instant; Text B omits this timing restriction.

cards.name: Forbidden Orchard
lines: Whenever you tap this land for mana, target opponent creates a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this land is tapped for mana, target opponent creates a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.
differences: Text A triggers only when the controller of the land (you) taps it for mana; Text B triggers whenever this land is tapped for mana by anyone.

cards.name: Oran-Rief, the Vastwood
lines: {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each green creature that entered this turn.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each green creature that entered this turn.

cards.name: Elvish Spirit Guide
lines: Exile this card from your hand: Add {G}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no mana ability that is activated from hand by exiling this card as a cost; the only hand-zone activated form is a stack ability with no exile-self-from-hand cost, so its mana would be added on resolution rather than immediately.

cards.name: Terrasymbiosis
lines: Whenever you put one or more +1/+1 counters on a creature you control, you may draw that many cards. Do this only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no Value for the number of +1/+1 counters placed by the triggering event, so 'you may draw that many cards' cannot be expressed (triggerCount counts objects, not counters).

cards.name: Kenrith's Transformation
lines: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green Elk creature with base power and toughness 3/3.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature is a green Creature — Elk with base power and toughness 3/3 and loses all abilities.

cards.name: Eldritch Evolution
lines: Search your library for a creature card with mana value X or less, where X is 2 plus the sacrificed creature's mana value. Put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search's mana value limit is X plus the sacrificed creature's mana value, and manaValueAtMost takes only a constant while no value reads the mana value of a sacrificed cost object.

cards.name: Liliana, Dreadhorde General
lines: −9: Each opponent chooses a permanent they control of each permanent type and sacrifices the rest.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only permanent-type sacrifice op (choosePermanentTypesThenSacrificeOthers) has the controller make the choices and sacrifices only nonland permanents, but the -9 has each opponent choose and sacrifices lands too.

cards.name: Drannith Magistrate
lines: Your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The rule statics have no restriction that stops opponents casting spells from zones other than their hand; cantCastSpells bans all casting and castFromZone only grants permissions.

cards.name: Elspeth, Sun's Champion
lines: −7: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have flying."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The −7 emblem's static "creatures you control get +2/+2 and have flying" cannot be carried: createEmblem takes only triggered, activated or spell Abilities, and no static effect field exists for an emblem.

cards.name: Reassembling Skeleton
lines: {1}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Returning the source from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped has no exact op: returnDepartedSourceToBattlefield has no tapped option, and returnDiedSourceToBattlefield's tapped option is defined for a source that died rather than an activated ability's own card.

cards.name: Priest of Titania
lines: {T}: Add {G} for each Elf on the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Add {G} for each Elf on the battlefield.

cards.name: Vanquish the Horde
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature on the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs less to cast by an amount equal to the number of creatures on the battlefield.

cards.name: Steel Overseer
lines: {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.

cards.name: Escape Tunnel
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this land: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'creature with power 2 or less' needs powerAtMost, which the schema marks event-only, so it cannot be checked as a target filter.

cards.name: High Tide
lines: Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The extra {U} goes to the player who tapped the Island, but addMana adds mana only to the ability's controller, and no until-end-of-turn trigger can watch every player's Island taps while giving the mana to that tapping player.

cards.name: Veyran, Voice of Duality
lines: If you casting or copying an instant or sorcery spell causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: triggerAdditionalTime doubles triggers from a permanent filter with no condition on the event that caused them, so it cannot be limited to triggers caused by casting or copying an instant or sorcery spell.

cards.name: Tocasia's Welcome
lines: Whenever one or more creatures you control with mana value 3 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever one or more creatures you control with mana value 3 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers no more than once each turn.

cards.name: Coruscation Mage
lines: Offspring {2}
cards.backTranslation:
As you cast this spell, you may pay an additional {2}. (Offspring)
When this creature enters, create a token that is a copy of this creature, except its base power and toughness are 1/1. Create one such token for each time the offspring cost was paid.

cards.name: Gilded Goose
lines: {T}, Sacrifice a Food: Add one mana of any color.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Sacrifice a Food you control: Add one mana of any color.

cards.name: Colossus Hammer
lines: Equipped creature gets +10/+10 and loses flying.
cards.backTranslation: Equipped creature gets +10/+10 and loses flying.

cards.name: Mizzix's Mastery
lines: Exile target card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect copies an instant or sorcery card exiled from the graveyard and lets its controller cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: The Fire Crystal
lines: {4}{R}{R}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.backTranslation: {4}{R}{R}, {T}: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control. Sacrifice that token at the beginning of the end step.
differences: Text A sacrifices the token at the beginning of the next end step; Text B sacrifices it at the beginning of 'the end step', which does not specify the next one, so the timing can differ (for example, when activated during an end step).

cards.name: Enduring Curiosity
lines: When ~ dies, if it was a creature, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. It's an enchantment.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'It's an enchantment' part needs the returned object alone to lose the creature type, but the only layer-4 removeCreatureType static would apply to Enduring Curiosity at all times, so no form captures that only the returned permanent is not a creature.

cards.name: High Fae Trickster
lines: You may cast spells as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no rule static or effect that lets the controller cast spells as though they had flash, so 'You may cast spells as though they had flash' cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Buster Sword
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then you may cast a spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to that damage without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: castOneFromHandFreeUpTo takes a fixed maxManaValue number, so 'mana value less than or equal to that damage' (the damage dealt) cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Urza's Tower
lines: {T}: Add {C}. If you control an Urza's Mine and an Urza's Power-Plant, add {C}{C}{C} instead.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Add {C}. If you control at least one permanent with the subtype Urza's and the subtype Mine, and at least one permanent with the subtype Urza's and the subtype Power-Plant, add {C}{C}{C} instead.

cards.name: Wonder
lines: As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control an Island, creatures you control have flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A static that grants flying to creatures you control only while this card is in the graveyard (and you control an Island) cannot be expressed, because staticEffects and their conditions do not function from the graveyard zone.

cards.name: Urza's Mine
lines: {T}: Add {C}. If you control an Urza's Power-Plant and an Urza's Tower, add {C}{C} instead.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Add {C}. If you control a permanent with the subtype Urza's Power-Plant and a permanent with the subtype Urza's Tower, add {C}{C} instead.

cards.name: Ledger Shredder
lines: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, this creature connives.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a player casts their second spell each turn, connive.

cards.name: Urza's Power Plant
lines: {T}: Add {C}. If you control an Urza's Mine and an Urza's Tower, add {C}{C} instead.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Add {C}. If you control at least one Urza's Mine and at least one Urza's Tower, add {C}{C} instead.

cards.name: Ghost Quarter
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield untapped.
differences: Text A says the controller may search for a basic land, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle; Text B omits the shuffle.

cards.name: Gyre Sage
lines: Evolve
cards.inexpressibleReason: Evolve's trigger needs the entering creature's toughness compared with this creature's, and the schema has no value for another object's toughness (only powerOfTriggerObject).

cards.name: The Mycosynth Gardens
lines: {X}, {T}: ~ becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'nontoken artifact you control with mana value X' compares against the announced X of the {X} cost, and no selector can match a mana value equal to an announced value (only fixed manaValueAtMost or manaValueAtLeast with a constant n).

cards.name: Ripples of Potential
lines: Proliferate, then choose any number of permanents you control that had a counter put on them this way. Those permanents phase out.
cards.inexpressibleReason: After proliferate, the player chooses any number of permanents that just received a counter and phases them out; no effect selects a subset of the proliferated permanents (phaseOutEachChosen takes parsed target slots, not a post-proliferate choice).

cards.name: Cephalid Coliseum
lines: {U}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Target player draws three cards, then discards three cards. Activate only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: {U}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Target player draws three cards, then discards three cards. Activate only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Lotus Field
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice two lands.
cards.backTranslation: When this land enters, sacrifice a land. Then sacrifice a land.

cards.name: Raise the Palisade
lines: Choose a creature type. Return all creatures that aren't of the chosen type to their owners' hands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The controller must choose a creature type as this spell resolves, and the schema's chosen-type option (entersChoosingOption) exists only for permanents as they enter, not for a resolving spell.

cards.name: The Wind Crystal
lines: If you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No replacement effect doubles life gained: ruleStatics cover only damage doubling and counter or token multipliers, so 'if you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead' cannot be said.

cards.name: Ashaya, Soul of the Wild
lines: Nontoken creatures you control are Forest lands in addition to their other types.
cards.backTranslation: Each nontoken creature you control is a Land Forest in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
lines: If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no replacement static that doubles life loss suffered by opponents during your turn (damageDoubled covers damage only).

cards.name: Fiery Emancipation
lines: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage to that permanent or player instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's damage replacements only double damage (damageDoubled, damageDoubledToOpponents) or halve it, with no multiplier for tripling.

cards.name: Curse of the Swine
lines: Exile X target creatures. For each creature exiled this way, its controller creates a 2/2 green Boar creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A variable X number of target creatures (announced X, not a TargetSpec count range) with a token created for each exiled creature's controller has no schema form.

cards.name: Evendo, Waking Haven
lines: 12+ | {G}, {T}: Add {G} for each creature you control.
cards.backTranslation: {G}, {T}: Add {G} for each creature you control. Activate only if this land has twelve or more charge counters on it.

cards.name: Splendid Reclamation
lines: Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: graveyardToBattlefieldEach has no tapped option, so the land cards cannot be returned tapped.

cards.name: Xorn
lines: If you would create one or more Treasure tokens, instead create those tokens plus an additional Treasure token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only token-count replacement (tokenCountMultiplier) applies to every token, not only Treasure tokens, and no Treasure-specific extra-token replacement exists.

cards.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
lines: Whenever ~ or another black creature you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature or another black creature you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Reconnaissance
lines: {0}: Remove target attacking creature you control from combat and untap it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect removes one targeted attacking creature from combat: removeAttackersFromCombat acts on every attacker, so the single-target removal and untap cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Scrap Trawler
lines: Whenever this creature dies or another artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return to your hand target artifact card in your graveyard with lesser mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'with lesser mana value' compares against the mana value of the triggering artifact, and no selector or Value reads the trigger object's mana value (manaValueOfTarget reads only a declared target).

cards.name: Blade of Selves
lines: Equipped creature has myriad.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no myriad keyword or myriad token-copy effect (myriad is not in IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS and no op creates attacking token copies for each other opponent).

cards.name: Thousand-Year Elixir
lines: You may activate abilities of creatures you control as though those creatures had haste.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Activating creatures' abilities as though they had haste (ignoring summoning sickness for {T} abilities only) has no schema form, and granting the haste keyword would also wrongly allow attacking.

cards.name: Tragic Slip
lines: That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if a creature died this turn.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. If a creature died this turn, that creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead.

cards.name: Myr Retriever
lines: When this creature dies, return another target artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Another' excludes the source only for permanents (the other selector), and the schema does not define that exclusion for a graveyard card target, so it could return Myr Retriever itself.

cards.name: Tempt with Discovery
lines: Search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield. Each opponent may search their library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield. For each opponent who searches a library this way, search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield. Then each player who searched a library this way shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no op for an opponent's optional library search, and no op for a search whose count depends on how many opponents chose to search, so the 'each opponent may search' branch and its follow-up searches cannot be modeled exactly.

cards.name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control the artifact with the greatest mana value or tied for the greatest mana value, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The upkeep intervening-if "you control the artifact with the greatest mana value or tied for the greatest" compares one artifact's mana value with the greatest among your artifacts, and the schema's Condition kinds cannot make that comparison (manaValueAtLeast takes only a constant).

cards.name: Kappa Cannoneer
lines: Whenever this creature or another artifact you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. It can't be blocked this turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature or another artifact you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and it can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Descent into Avernus
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, put two descent counters on this enchantment. Then each player creates X Treasure tokens and this enchantment deals X damage to each player, where X is the number of descent counters on this enchantment.
cards.backTranslation:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put two descent counters on this enchantment. Then create a Treasure token for each descent counter on this enchantment. Each opponent creates a Treasure token for each descent counter on this enchantment. Then this enchantment deals damage to each player equal to the number of descent counters on it.
A Treasure token has "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color."

cards.name: Loot, Exuberant Explorer
lines: {4}{G}{G}, {T}: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card with mana value less than or equal to the number of lands you control from among them and put it onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The creature choice is limited to mana value at most the number of lands you control, but Selector manaValueAtMost takes only a fixed number and lookAtTopN has no mana-value limit.

cards.name: Tainted Pact
lines: Exile the top card of your library. You may put that card into your hand unless it has the same name as another card exiled this way. Repeat this process until you put a card into your hand or you exile two cards with the same name, whichever comes first.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The repeated exile-the-top-card loop that stops at the first card put into hand or the first repeated name has no schema form (no repeat-until construct and no name match between exiled cards).

cards.name: Grim Hireling
lines: {B}, Sacrifice X Treasures: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost "Sacrifice X Treasures" with X announced at activation has no schema form: sacrificeOther takes only a fixed count, and the -X/-X cannot read that announced X.

cards.name: Burgeoning
lines: Whenever an opponent plays a land, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger watches an opponent playing a land; the trigger events have no land-played event.

cards.name: Essence Flux
lines: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. If it's a Spirit, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The +1/+1 counter must go on the creature as it returns, a new object (CR 400.7), and no effect can reference the returned card after blinkTarget, so the 'if it's a Spirit, put a +1/+1 counter on it' half cannot be stated.

cards.name: Sword of Hearth and Home
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, exile up to one target creature you own, then search your library for a basic land card. Put both cards onto the battlefield under your control, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, blink up to one target creature you own. Return that creature under the control of this Equipment's controller. Then search a library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield. Then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches your library for the basic land; Text B searches a library, which allows searching any player's library.
Text A puts the land onto the battlefield under your control; Text B does not say who controls the land.

cards.name: Archway of Innovation
lines: {U}, {T}: The next spell you cast this turn has improvise.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that gives the next spell you cast this turn improvise; the improvise RuleStatic applies only to the permanent that prints it.

cards.name: Field of Ruin
lines: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Each player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield, then shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect where each player (including the controller, mandatorily) searches for a basic land; the existing land-search effects only let the target's controller search optionally.

cards.name: Vesuva
lines: You may have this land enter tapped as a copy of any land on the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: entersAsCopy has no option for the optional 'enter tapped' choice, and entersTapped would make the land always enter tapped.

cards.name: Demonic Consultation
lines: Choose a card name. Exile the top six cards of your library, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card with the chosen name. Put that card into your hand and exile all other cards revealed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets the controller choose a card name and then exile the top six cards and reveal until a card with that chosen name.

cards.name: Myr Battlesphere
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, you may tap X untapped Myr you control. If you do, this creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn and deals X damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets the controller tap a chosen number X of untapped Myr as an attack-trigger cost and then use that same X for both the +X/+0 and the X damage (tapXOthers exists only as an activation cost).

cards.name: Resculpt
lines: Exile target artifact or creature. Its controller creates a 4/4 blue and red Elemental creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no single op that exiles a target and then creates a token for its controller (destroyAndCreateTokenForController is destroy-only), and composing exile with a token made for "its controller" would read the controller of an object that has already left the battlefield.

cards.name: Metallic Mimic
lines: ~ is the chosen type in addition to its other types.
cards.backTranslation: This creature is the chosen creature type in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Solphim, Mayhem Dominus
lines: If a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals double that damage to that player or permanent instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's damage-doubling statics (damageDoubledToOpponents, damageDoubled) have no noncombat-only restriction, so they would also double combat damage that this line leaves alone.

cards.name: Evolution Witness
lines: {1}{G}: Adapt 2.
cards.backTranslation: {G}: If there are no +1/+1 counters on this creature, put two +1/+1 counters on it.
differences: The activation cost is {1}{G} in Text A but {G} in Text B.

cards.name: Desperate Ritual
lines: Splice onto Arcane {1}{R}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Splice onto Arcane (revealing this card from hand to add its effects to an Arcane spell) has no schema form.

cards.name: Cyberdrive Awakener
lines: When this creature enters, each noncreature artifact you control becomes a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: becomeCreatureUntilEot acts on one target, and the schema has no untargeted each-noncreature-artifact form that makes those permanents 4/4 artifact creatures until end of turn.

cards.name: Blightsteel Colossus
lines: If ~ would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal ~ and shuffle it into its owner's library instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has only a replacement that exiles a card going to a graveyard, not one that reveals it and shuffles it into its owner's library instead.

cards.name: Approach of the Second Sun
lines: If this spell was cast from your hand and you've cast another spell named ~ this game, you win the game. Otherwise, put ~ into its owner's library seventh from the top and you gain 7 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition for 'cast from your hand' combined with 'you have cast another spell with this name this game', so the win-the-game branch cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Coat of Arms
lines: Each creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature on the battlefield that shares at least one creature type with it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A count of other creatures sharing a creature type with each affected creature needs a per-affected-object value, and the schema's countPermanents is evaluated once for the source, not for each creature it affects.

cards.name: Devoted Druid
lines: Put a -1/-1 counter on this creature: Untap this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activation cost 'put a -1/-1 counter on this creature' has no AbilityCost kind; removeCounters only removes counters, so the cost cannot be expressed exactly.

cards.name: Archon of Cruelty
lines: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, target opponent sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice, discards a card, and loses 3 life. You draw a card and gain 3 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The sacrifice must be made by the targeted opponent alone, but sacrificeOneEachOpponent hits every opponent and sacrificeTargetPlayerCreature covers creatures only.

cards.name: Jaheira, Friend of the Forest
lines: Choose a Background
validatorIssues: override for "Jaheira, Friend of the Forest" has no executable behavior
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no form for "Choose a Background" (the deck-construction commander pairing rule).

cards.name: Cabaretti Courtyard
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Mountain, Forest, or Plains card (you may find none), put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
differences: Text B adds '(you may find none)', making the search optional; Text A's search is mandatory and the player must find a matching card if one exists.

cards.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
lines: {3}{G}{G}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's counter-doubling ops (doubleCountersEach and doubleCountersEachChosen) double every kind of counter, and none can double only +1/+1 counters as "double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control" requires.

cards.name: Karmic Guide
lines: Echo {3}{W}{W}
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no echo mechanic, and no condition for 'came under your control since the beginning of your last upkeep' that would limit the sacrifice-unless-paid upkeep trigger to the first upkeep.

cards.name: Cruel Celebrant
lines: Whenever this creature or another creature or planeswalker you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature dies, or another creature or planeswalker you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Inspiring Statuary
lines: Nonartifact spells you cast have improvise.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static grants improvise to nonartifact spells you cast; ruleStatics improvise applies only to the card itself.

cards.name: Mindcrank
lines: Whenever an opponent loses life, that player mills that many cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mill effect for the event player (millTargetPlayer) takes a fixed number of cards, so 'that player mills that many cards', where the number is the life lost, cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Eerie Interlude
lines: Exile any number of target creatures you control. Return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The creatures are a variable number of targets that must each return at the beginning of the next end step, and the delayed-return op (exileTargetReturnAtNextEndStep) takes a single target rather than a chosen set.

cards.name: Chain of Vapor
lines: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand. Then that permanent's controller may sacrifice a land of their choice. If the player does, they may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The copy is made by the player who chose to sacrifice a land (the permanent's controller), but copyTargetSpell copies for the spell's own controller and no effect lets another player copy the spell.

cards.name: Angel of the Ruins
lines: When this creature enters, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments.

cards.name: Fumigate
lines: Destroy all creatures. You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no count of creatures destroyed by this spell for the life gain; creaturesDiedThisTurn would also count earlier deaths that turn.

cards.name: Decimate
lines: Destroy target artifact, target creature, target enchantment, and target land.
cards.backTranslation: As this spell is cast, choose four targets: target artifact, target creature, target enchantment, and target land. Destroy each of those four targets.

cards.name: Serra Ascendant
lines: As long as you have 30 or more life, this creature gets +5/+5 and has flying.
cards.backTranslation: As long as you have 30 or more life, this creature gets +5/+5 and has flying.

cards.name: Combat Celebrant
lines: If this creature hasn't been exerted this turn, you may exert it as it attacks. When you do, untap all other creatures you control and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no exert mechanic: no optional exert-as-it-attacks choice, no exerted state, and no 'hasn't been exerted this turn' condition.

cards.name: Steelshaper's Gift
lines: Search your library for an Equipment card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: Search your library for an Equipment card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle.

cards.name: Force of Vigor
lines: Destroy up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments.
cards.backTranslation: Destroy up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments.

cards.name: Noxious Gearhulk
lines: When this creature enters, you may destroy another target creature. If a creature is destroyed this way, you gain life equal to its toughness.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The life gain 'equal to its toughness' needs the toughness of the destroyed target, and the schema has no toughness-of-target value (only powerOfTarget, manaValueOfTarget and toughnessOfSource).

cards.name: Nyxbloom Ancient
lines: If you tap a permanent for mana, it produces three times as much of that mana instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mana rider oneOfProducedTypes adds one mana, not a multiple of the produced mana, so tripling a permanent that produces several units (or any amount other than one extra) cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Omniscience
lines: You may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No rule static lets the controller cast spells from hand without paying their mana costs; castAnyFromHandFree is a one-time resolving effect, not a continuing permission.

cards.name: Krosan Verge
lines: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Search your library for a Forest card and a Plains card, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Search a library for a Forest card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. Search a library for a Plains card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. Then shuffle.
differences: Text A searches your library for the Forest and Plains cards; Text B searches a library, which allows searching any player's library.

cards.name: Genji Glove
lines: Whenever equipped creature attacks, if it's the first combat phase of the turn, untap it. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger's intervening clause 'if it's the first combat phase of the turn' has no condition in the schema, so the untap cannot be gated on the first combat phase.

cards.name: Spellskite
lines: {U/P}: Change a target of target spell or ability to this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: changeSingleTarget only changes a target to a newly chosen target; no effect redirects a target of a spell or ability to this specific creature.

cards.name: Training Grounds
lines: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The costReduction static has no documented way to restrict an activated-ability reduction to abilities of creatures you control (its filter is documented only for spells), so the 'creatures you control' scope cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Swarmyard
lines: {T}: Regenerate target Insect, Rat, Spider, or Squirrel.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Regenerate target permanent that is an Insect, Rat, Spider, or Squirrel.

cards.name: Pest Infestation
lines: Destroy up to X target artifacts and/or enchantments. Create twice X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'up to X target artifacts and/or enchantments' slot needs a target count tied to the announced X, but TargetSpec.count is a fixed {min, max} pair of numbers.

cards.name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
lines: Sacrifice another creature: ~ gains indestructible until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice another creature you control: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Destiny Spinner
lines: {3}{G}: Target land you control becomes an X/X Elemental creature with trample and haste until end of turn, where X is the number of enchantments you control. It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: becomeCreatureUntilEot takes fixed numeric power and toughness only, so the "X/X where X is the number of enchantments you control" cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Torbran, Thane of Red Fell
lines: If a red source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's damage replacements only double or halve damage; there is no 'deals that much damage plus 2' replacement for red sources.

cards.name: Roiling Regrowth
lines: Sacrifice a land. Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a land you control.
Search a library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped. Then shuffle.
differences: Text A makes the land sacrifice part of the spell's resolution effect; Text B makes it an additional cost paid on casting, with the sacrificed land restricted to lands you control.
Text A searches for up to two basic lands (zero or one is allowed); Text B searches for exactly two.
Text A searches your library; Text B searches a library, which allows searching any player's library.

cards.name: Charismatic Conqueror
lines: Whenever an artifact or creature an opponent controls enters untapped, they may tap that permanent. If they don't, you create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect by which the opponent (the event player) may tap the entering permanent with the controller creating a token if they decline, so the optional tap choice cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Spellseeker
lines: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card with mana value 2 or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle.

cards.name: Abandoned Air Temple
lines: ~ enters tapped unless you control a basic land.
cards.backTranslation: This land enters tapped unless you control at least one basic land.

cards.name: Slip Out the Back
lines: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It phases out.
validatorIssues: override.def.spellAbility.effects[1].targetSlot: effect target 0 does not reference a variable-count target slot
cards.backTranslation: Choose target creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on that creature. Phase out that creature.

cards.name: Ram Through
lines: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control. If the creature you control has trample, excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trample clause needs excess damage (the creature's power minus the target's toughness) dealt to the controller, and no Value expresses the target's toughness or a difference of two values.

cards.name: Mesmeric Orb
lines: Whenever a permanent becomes untapped, that permanent's controller mills a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for a permanent becoming untapped (only becomesTapped exists), so the untap trigger cannot be stated.

cards.name: Fertile Ground
lines: Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional one mana of any color.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever enchanted permanent is tapped for mana, it produces one additional mana of any one color.
differences: The card's enchant restriction is 'Enchant land', so it can only enchant a land; Text B says 'enchanted permanent', which would allow it to enchant any permanent.

cards.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
lines: ~ has all activated abilities of creatures you control that don't have the same name as this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot grant this creature all activated abilities of other creatures its controller controls that do not share its name, since the grant ops take one fixed ability object rather than a dynamic set copied from other permanents.

cards.name: Mishra's Bauble
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Look at the top card of target player's library. Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that only looks at the top card of a target player's library without moving it (lookAtTopN requires placing the cards), so the 'look at the top card of target player's library' part cannot be modeled exactly.

cards.name: Not Dead After All
lines: Until end of turn, target creature you control gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control, then create a Wicked Role token attached to it."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted ability's 'create a Wicked Role token attached to it' refers to the creature returned by the granted return effect, and the schema has no reference to that returned object for createAttachedToken.

cards.name: Alchemist's Refuge
lines: {G}{U}, {T}: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that lets spells be cast this turn as though they had flash (no flash-permission effect or rule static), so the activated ability cannot be modeled.

cards.name: Well of Lost Dreams
lines: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {X}, where X is less than or equal to the amount of life you gained. If you do, draw X cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no optional variable-X payment (pay {X}, X at most the life gained) whose paid amount sets the number of cards drawn; mayPayMana takes only a fixed cost.

cards.name: Nezahal, Primal Tide
lines: Discard three cards: Exile ~. Return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The delayed return must bring the card back tapped, and exileTargetReturnAtNextEndStep has no tapped option (it returns untapped).

cards.name: Shalai, Voice of Plenty
lines: You, planeswalkers you control, and other creatures you control have hexproof.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no static that gives the controller player hexproof ('You ... have hexproof'); only the one-shot controllerHexproofUntilEot effect exists.

cards.name: Kalonian Hydra
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: doubleCountersEach doubles every kind of counter on each creature you control, and the schema has no op that doubles only +1/+1 counters.

cards.name: Plumb the Forbidden
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may sacrifice one or more creatures. When you do, copy this spell for each creature sacrificed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no optional additional cost that sacrifices a variable number of creatures and then copies the spell once for each creature actually sacrificed (sacrificeOther takes a fixed count, and replicateCopies takes a fixed count).

cards.name: Crackle with Power
