lines: ~ deals five times X damage to each of up to X targets.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A target slot's count is a fixed {min,max} range, so 'up to X targets' cannot be bounded by the announced X.

cards.name: Grasp of Fate
lines: When this enchantment enters, for each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to limit a per-player "up to one target" slot to opponents only (TargetSpec.perPlayer expands over each player, including yourself), so "for each opponent, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls" cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Luminous Broodmoth
lines: Whenever a creature you control without flying dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect returns the dying creature (the trigger object) to the battlefield with a flying counter on it: returnDiedSourceToBattlefield covers only the ability's own source, and the trigger-object returns are tapped-only or delayed.

cards.name: Spymaster's Vault
lines: {B}, {T}: Target creature you control connives X, where X is the number of creatures that died this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The connive op takes no count, so it cannot have the connive count X equal to the number of creatures that died this turn.

cards.name: Fiery Inscription
lines: When this enchantment enters, the Ring tempts you.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect in the schema makes a player the Ring-bearer or has the Ring tempt a player.

cards.name: Augur of Autumn
lines: As long as you control three or more creatures with different powers, you may cast creature spells from the top of your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The castFromZone library-top permission has no condition field, and the schema has no condition for 'three or more creatures with different powers' (Coven), so the permission cannot be limited to that state.

cards.name: Revel in Riches
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control ten or more Treasures, you win the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that makes the controller win the game.

cards.name: Recruiter of the Guard
lines: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a creature card with toughness 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Selector schema has toughnessAtLeast but no toughness-at-most leaf, so 'creature card with toughness 2 or less' cannot be filtered.

cards.name: Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
lines: Whenever you attack with one or more non-Gnome creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on ~, then create X 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature tokens that are tapped and attacking, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on ~.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you attack with one or more creatures that aren't Gnomes, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Then create a 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature token that is attacking, for each +1/+1 counter on this creature.
differences: Text A creates the Gnome tokens tapped and attacking; Text B creates them only attacking, so they enter untapped.

cards.name: Triumph of the Hordes
lines: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain trample and infect.
cards.backTranslation:
Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Creatures you control gain trample and infect until end of turn.

cards.name: The Black Gate
lines: {1}{B}, {T}: Choose a player with the most life or tied for most life. Target creature can't be blocked by creatures that player controls this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: cantBeBlockedUntilEot makes the target unblockable by all creatures; the schema cannot say it can't be blocked by only the creatures of the chosen player with the most life.

cards.name: Homeward Path
lines: {T}: Each player gains control of all creatures they own.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Regain control of each creature you own.
differences: Text A makes each player gain control of all creatures they own; Text B makes only the controller regain control of creatures that player owns, so other players are not affected in B.

cards.name: The Shire
lines: ~ enters tapped unless you control a legendary creature.
cards.backTranslation: This land enters tapped unless you control a legendary creature.

cards.name: Millikin
lines: {T}, Mill a card: Add {C}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activation cost 'Mill a card' has no AbilityCost kind, and a mana ability's rider can only damage, gain life, or put counters, so the mill cannot be paid as part of the mana ability.

cards.name: Ezuri's Predation
lines: For each creature your opponents control, create a 4/4 green Phyrexian Beast creature token. Each of those tokens fights a different one of those creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each token must fight a different one of the opposing creatures (a one-to-one pairing of tokens to those creatures), and the schema's fight op takes a single pair of EffectRefs with no per-object pairing across a created set.

cards.name: Captain Lannery Storm
lines: Whenever you sacrifice a Treasure, ~ gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a Treasure you control is sacrificed, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods
lines: When ~ enters, mill four cards. Then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: graveyardToBattlefieldEach has no tapped option, so the return of all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Mount Doom
lines: {5}{B}{R}, {T}, Sacrifice ~ and a legendary artifact: Choose up to two creatures, then destroy the rest. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect destroys every creature except up to two chosen ones (the choose-then-destroy-the-rest form); destroyEachChosen destroys only the chosen objects.

cards.name: Notion Thief
lines: If an opponent would draw a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no draw-replacement effect: 'instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card' for an opponent's draws (except the first in their draw step) has no ruleStatics or effect kind.

cards.name: Wheel of Misfortune
lines: Each player secretly chooses a number 0 or greater, then all players reveal those numbers simultaneously and determine the highest and lowest numbers revealed this way. ~ deals damage equal to the highest number to each player who chose that number. Each player who didn't choose the lowest number discards their hand, then draws seven cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no simultaneous secret numeric choice by each player, no reveal-and-compare of the highest and lowest numbers, and no damage equal to the highest number chosen.

cards.name: Uthros, Titanic Godcore
lines: 12+ | {U}, {T}: Add {U} for each artifact you control.
cards.backTranslation: {U}, {T}: Add {U} for each artifact you control. Activate only if this land has at least twelve charge counters on it.

cards.name: Arachnogenesis
lines: Create X 1/2 green Spider creature tokens with reach, where X is the number of creatures attacking you. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by non-Spider creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The prevention applies only to combat damage from non-Spider creatures, and no damage prevention filter by creature subtype exists (preventCombatDamageAll prevents all combat damage).

cards.name: Amphibian Downpour
lines: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a blue Frog creature with base power and toughness 1/1.
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature is a blue Frog, its card type is Creature, it loses all abilities, and its base power and toughness are 1/1.

cards.name: Formidable Speaker
lines: When this creature enters, you may discard a card. If you do, search your library for a creature card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search happens only if a discard was made, but the trigger's optional flag covers the whole ability, so the search could fire with no discard and no schema op gates a search on a discard.

cards.name: Bane of Progress
lines: When this creature enters, destroy all artifacts and enchantments. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each permanent destroyed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The +1/+1 counters equal the number of permanents destroyed by the same ability, and no Value reads a count of objects destroyed by an earlier effect in the same resolution.

cards.name: Umbral Collar Zealot
lines: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Surveil 1.
cards.backTranslation: Sacrifice another creature or artifact you control: Surveil 1.

cards.name: Lethal Scheme
lines: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Each creature that convoked this spell connives.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect or value reads which creatures convoked the spell, so 'each creature that convoked this spell connives' cannot be said.

cards.name: Agate Instigator
lines: Offspring {1}{R}
cards.backTranslation:
Offspring {1}{R}
When this creature enters, create a number of tokens that are copies of this creature equal to the number of times the offspring cost was paid. Each of those tokens has base power and toughness 1/1.

cards.name: Kambal, Profiteering Mayor
lines: Whenever one or more tokens your opponents control enter, for each of them, create a tapped token that's a copy of it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect creates a tapped token copy of each token in an aggregate enter group; createTokenCopyOfEventGroupMember copies only one chosen member, and the copies cannot be made tapped in that form.

cards.name: Coveted Jewel
lines: Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked, that player draws three cards and gains control of this artifact. Untap it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect can give control of this artifact to the attacking opponent (the trigger's event player); gainControl takes a selector and gainControlTarget takes a target slot or the controller, not the event player.

cards.name: K'rrik, Son of Yawgmoth
lines: For each {B} in a cost, you may pay 2 life rather than pay that mana.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no rule-static that lets you pay 2 life for each {B} in your spells' and abilities' costs; the only Phyrexian pips are fixed in a card's own printed cost.

cards.name: Secret Tunnel
lines: {4}, {T}: Two target creatures you control that share a creature type can't be blocked this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Two target creatures that must share a creature type cannot be expressed: TargetSpec has no constraint tying the chosen objects of two slots to a shared creature type (differentFromSlots only forbids choosing the same object).

cards.name: Topiary Stomper
lines: ~ can't attack or block unless you control seven or more lands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no conditional "can't attack or block unless you control seven or more lands" restriction on the creature itself: the attack and block restriction statics take no lands-count condition, and StaticEffect ops have no can't-attack or can't-block form.

cards.name: Aven Mindcensor
lines: If an opponent would search a library, that player searches the top four cards of that library instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no search-replacement effect: "if an opponent would search a library, that player searches the top four cards instead" needs a replacement on library searches, and no RuleStatic or StaticEffect kind can express it.

cards.name: Past in Flames
lines: Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants flashback to the instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard with a cost equal to each card's mana cost; the schema has no flashback-granting op.

cards.name: Balefire Dragon
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, it deals that much damage to each creature that player controls.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, this creature deals that much damage to each creature. This damage is dealt from this creature, treated as controlled by the player it dealt combat damage to.
differences: Text A deals the damage only to each creature that the player it hit controls; Text B deals it to each creature, including the source's controller's own creatures.
Text B says the damage is treated as controlled by the player it dealt combat damage to, which Text A does not state.

cards.name: Rosie Cotton of South Lane
lines: Whenever you create a token, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control other than ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no documented trigger for "whenever you create a token" (tokenCreated's subject and creator matching are not specified), so the trigger cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Vexing Bauble
lines: Whenever a player casts a spell, if no mana was spent to cast it, counter that spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Counter that spell' needs the triggering spell as the counter's target, but counter takes only an announced target slot index and no effect reference names the spell that fired the trigger.

cards.name: Scapeshift
lines: Sacrifice any number of lands. Search your library for up to that many land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The search count is 'up to that many' where that is the number of lands the controller chose to sacrifice, and no Value reads a count of permanents sacrificed by the same resolution.

cards.name: Hedge Shredder
lines: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from your library, put them onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for cards put into your graveyard from your library by a mill event, nor an effect that puts those event cards onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Nuka-Cola Vending Machine
lines: Whenever you sacrifice a Food, create a tapped Treasure token.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a Food you control is sacrificed, create a tapped Treasure artifact token. That token has "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."
differences: Text A triggers when you sacrifice a Food (you are the sacrificing player); Text B triggers when a Food you control is sacrificed by anyone, so it also fires when an opponent or an effect makes you sacrifice a Food.

cards.name: Defense of the Heart
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, if an opponent controls three or more creatures, sacrifice this enchantment, search your library for up to two creature cards, put those cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The intervening-if 'an opponent controls three or more creatures' is per opponent, but countPermanents with scope 'opponents' pools every opponent's creatures into one count, so the threshold cannot be checked for a single opponent.

cards.name: Dakmor Salvage
lines: Dredge 2
cards.inexpressibleReason: Dredge 2 is not a keyword or effect in the schema (the mill-then-return replacement on draws has no representation).

cards.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
lines: {T}: Add an amount of {G} equal to ~'s power.
validatorIssues: override.def.manaAbilities[0].amount: mana amount a mana ability cannot evaluate
cards.inexpressibleReason: A mana ability amount cannot read the source's current power (powerOfSource is not evaluable there, and countersOnSelf would ignore other power modifiers).

cards.name: Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle
lines: Whenever a Mountain you control enters, if you control at least five other Mountains, you may have this land deal 3 damage to any target.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a Mountain you control enters, if you control five or more Mountains, you may have this deal 3 damage to any target.
differences: Text A requires at least five OTHER Mountains besides the entering Mountain; Text B requires five or more Mountains, which counts the entering Mountain, so the trigger condition is met one Mountain earlier in B.

cards.name: Peer into the Abyss
lines: Target player draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library and loses half their life. Round up each time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no halving value, so 'draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library' and 'loses half their life, round up' cannot be stated exactly (Value offers only plus, negate and times).

cards.name: Maestros Theater
lines: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: When this land enters, sacrifice this land. When you do, search your library for a basic land card with the supertype Basic and the subtype Island, Swamp, or Mountain. The search may fail to find a card. If a card is found, put it onto the battlefield tapped. Then shuffle, and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Undying Malice
lines: Until end of turn, target creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it."
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it" until end of turn.

cards.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
lines: {T}: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary creature you control, except it has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Create a token that is a copy of target creature you control that isn't legendary. The token has haste. Sacrifice the token at the beginning of the end step.

cards.name: Conqueror's Flail
lines: As long as this Equipment is attached to a creature, your opponents can't cast spells during your turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cantCastSpells rule static has no condition for 'as long as this Equipment is attached to a creature', so the attached-only restriction cannot be stated.

cards.name: Experimental Augury
lines: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. Proliferate.
cards.backTranslation: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put a card from among them into your hand; this put is required. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. Then proliferate.

cards.name: Martial Coup
lines: Create X 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens. If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures" must spare the Soldier tokens just created, and no selector excludes exactly those tokens (a not-entered-this-turn filter would also spare other creatures that entered this turn).

cards.name: Timeless Witness
lines: Eternalize {5}{G}{G}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Eternalize's token copy is a 4/4 black Zombie with no mana cost, and createTokenCopyOf has no field to set the copy's color or add a subtype, so the black color and Zombie subtype cannot be stated.

cards.name: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if you control no creatures with decayed, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Decayed (a token keyword that cannot block and is sacrificed at end of combat) is not a KeywordAbility in the schema, so the token and its end-step condition cannot be stated.

cards.name: Finale of Revelation
lines: Draw X cards. If X is 10 or more, instead shuffle your graveyard into your library, draw X cards, untap up to five lands, and you have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The X>=10 branch grants 'no maximum hand size for the rest of the game', but noMaximumHandSize is an unconditional rule static with no condition, and no effect shuffles only the graveyard into the library.

cards.name: Whir of Invention
lines: Search your library for an artifact card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: searchLibrary's manaValueAtMost takes a fixed number, so it cannot bound the artifact by the announced X, and the X-bounded search that does take a Value (searchLibraryAndOrGraveyardToBattlefield) also allows the graveyard.

cards.name: Palantír of Orthanc
lines: At the beginning of your end step, put an influence counter on ~ and scry 2. Then target opponent may have you draw a card. If that player doesn't, you mill X cards, where X is the number of influence counters on ~, and that player loses life equal to the total mana value of those cards.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The influence-counter mill count is dynamic (X = influence counters on the source) and the opponent's refusal costs life equal to the total mana value of the milled cards; opponentMayDrawOrMillThenDamage takes fixed counts and deals damage rather than causing life loss, so the line cannot be modeled exactly.

cards.name: Staff of Compleation
lines: {T}, Pay 1 life: Destroy target permanent you own.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Pay 1 life: Destroy target permanent you own.

cards.name: Dolmen Gate
lines: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to attacking creatures you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Preventing combat damage dealt to all attacking creatures you control has no schema op: preventCombatDamageAll prevents all combat damage, preventCombatDamageToSelf covers only the source, and createDamageShield covers one object or one player.

cards.name: Shimmer Myr
lines: You may cast artifact spells as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The RuleStatic schema has no way to let the controller cast artifact spells as though they had flash.

cards.name: Leyline Axe
lines: If this card is in your opening hand, you may begin the game with it on the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: If this card is in an opening hand, it begins the game on the battlefield.
differences: Text A lets you choose to begin the game on the battlefield ("you may"); Text B makes it mandatory.

cards.name: Persist
lines: Return target nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Returning the card with a -1/-1 counter needs a counter kind name the schema never shows for -1/-1 counters, and graveyardToBattlefield has no counter field.

cards.name: Carpet of Flowers
lines: At the beginning of each of your main phases, if you haven't added mana with this ability this turn, you may add X mana of any one color, where X is the number of Islands target opponent controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The intervening-if 'if you haven't added mana with this ability this turn' has no schema form: oncePerTurn limits trigger firings, not mana added by this ability, so a declined first main phase would wrongly block the second.

cards.name: Asceticism
lines: {1}{G}: Regenerate target creature.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{G}: Regenerate target creature.

cards.name: Genesis Wave
lines: Reveal the top X cards of your library. You may put any number of permanent cards with mana value X or less from among them onto the battlefield. Then put all cards revealed this way that weren't put onto the battlefield into your graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: partitionLibrary takes a fixed count and sends the rest to hand, not the graveyard, and there is no X-revealed permanent-with-mana-value-X-or-less put-onto-battlefield choice that sends the rest to the graveyard.

cards.name: Scroll Rack
lines: {1}, {T}: Exile any number of cards from your hand face down. Put that many cards from the top of your library into your hand. Then look at the exiled cards and put them on top of your library in any order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that exiles a chosen number of hand cards, draws that same number, and then puts the exiled cards on top of the library.

cards.name: Ad Nauseam
lines: Reveal the top card of your library and put that card into your hand. You lose life equal to its mana value. You may repeat this process any number of times.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way to repeat the reveal-top-card, put-in-hand, and lose-life sequence any number of times at the controller's choice.

cards.name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
lines: {T}, Sacrifice two other creatures: Any number of target players each lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature of their choice. You add {B}{B} and draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each of any number of chosen players must both lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature, and no chosen-player op pairs those two actions (discardChosenPlayers and millAndLoseLifeChosenPlayers each do a different pair).

cards.name: Giver of Runes
lines: {T}: Another target creature you control gains protection from colorless or from the color of your choice until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: ProtectionQuality has no colorless option, and the schema cannot express the either-or choice between protection from colorless and protection from a chosen color.

cards.name: All Will Be One
lines: Whenever you put one or more counters on a permanent or player, this enchantment deals that much damage to target opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The damage equals the number of counters placed, and no Value reads the count of counters in a countersPut event, while the target 'opponent, creature an opponent controls, or planeswalker an opponent controls' has no single target kind with that controller restriction.

cards.name: Electrodominance
lines: ~ deals X damage to any target. You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: castOneFromHandFreeUpTo takes a fixed number for maxManaValue, not a Value, so 'mana value X or less' where X is the announced value cannot be stated.

cards.name: Bulk Up
lines: Double target creature's power until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Double target creature's power.
differences: Text A doubles the power until end of turn; Text B has no duration, so the power doubling is permanent.
